title: Always On Top not showing context menu action on Firefox window title bar
summary: The Always On Top menu entry is absent from Firefox title-bar right-click despite the shortcut working.

judgment.rationale: The report has a concrete scenario, but the affected boundary is unverified.
evidence: On 0.99.1 the reporter can toggle Always On Top by keyboard, but the expected title-bar context-menu entry does not appear in Firefox.
The issue does not state Firefox title-bar customization or whether the Windows system menu was used.
Inspected src/modules/alwaysontop/AlwaysOnTop/AlwaysOnTop.cpp: the menu integration uses GetSystemMenu and InsertMenuItemW on the native system menu when enabled.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported scenario on a current build and isolate the failing boundary before choosing a correction.

fix_assessment.rationale: A targeted correction may be applicable after the reported behavior and boundary are confirmed.

proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Firefox system-menu availability
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Firefox may present a custom title-bar context menu rather than the native Windows system menu; the reported configuration and menu type are unknown.
plan: Check current Firefox with and without its native title-bar option and compare right-click with Alt+Space.
Determine whether PowerToys receives a native system-menu event and whether the insertion succeeds.
If the native menu is affected, correct the confirmed integration boundary; if Firefox shows a separate custom menu, assess feasibility without modifying or impersonating its menu.
Add regression coverage for native system menus and an appropriate manual check for Firefox configurations.
verification: Native system-menu integration remains usable on supported windows with the setting enabled.
Keyboard toggling and unrelated Firefox menu behavior remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The scenario and relevant source path are known, but current behavior and the failing boundary are unverified.

reproduce.title: Investigate Firefox system-menu availability
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release and compare with 0.99.1 where practical.
prerequisites: Use a Windows test machine and preserve the original configuration.
setup: Enable Always On Top and the setting that shows its command in the Windows system menu; install Firefox.
steps: 1. Open Firefox with its title-bar option disabled and right-click its title area; note the menu contents.
2. Press Alt+Space to open the Windows system menu and check for the Always On Top command.
3. Enable Firefox’s native title bar, repeat both menu paths, and compare with a standard Win32 window.
4. Confirm the shortcut still toggles the Firefox window and determine whether the affected menu is native or application-owned.
reproduce.expected_result: The Always On Top command is available in supported native Windows system menus; the shortcut remains functional.
